name: Sengoku Baccarat
detailed_description:
”Sengoku Baccarat” is a fusion of the casino card game “Baccarat” and a Roguelike card battle game.
Test your luck, go with the flow when you can, rebel a little when you need to. Fight your way through the masses of demons!


[About the game]
・Battle with Baccarat!
　The battle system is based on the casino game Baccarat. If you have the better hand, you get to attack! If your hand is weaker, the enemy gets to attack. But even if your cards don’t look good, don’t give up! 　　Make use of your skills and items to reinvent your hand and strengthen your attack and defense stats!

・Deck Building
　Find Talismans (Skill cards) on your journey to strengthen your deck!
　Discover combinations you can use to pave your way to victory!

・Items to Collect!
　There are Amulets (Relics) that can give you passive skills and Scrolls (Potions) that can fortify you temporarily.
　Use these items in tandem with your Talismans for powerful effects!

・Roguelike
　Every time you start a game, the map changes. You’ll never travel the same map twice. (Although, it is possible to recreate the map through the SEED value.)
　Apart from fighting enemies in the map, you’ll bump into events that require you to make decisions, and you may also find a merchant that will sell you items.
　Prepare yourself for what’s to come!



[The Story]
It is the year 20XX. A giant rift appears in the border that separates the “mortal world” (Utsushi-yo) from the “everlasting world” (Toko-yo).
As the balance between the two worlds crumble, the inhabitants of Toko-yo overflow into the Utsushi-yo, our mortal world. Ghosts, spirits, demons, even incarnations of gods and Buddha enter the Utsushi-yo, causing chaos.

With intention of suppressing the situation, the government attempts to fight these malignant spirits using military force, but their efforts are in vain; normal methods of warfare are not effective against the entities of Toko-yo, known as “Bakara”, who exist under different sets of logic altogether.

Setsuna, a swordsman who wields the “demon slayer sword” which has been passed down for generations, may be mankind’s last hope to save the world. He makes his way to the rift, now named the “Oomikado”…

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: Core 2 Duo or above
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 9.0 compatible or above
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
